description: Generate a Solana wallet whose base58 address starts with a chosen prefix (and optionally ends with a chosen suffix). Set `mnemonic: true` to receive a BIP-39 SEED PHRASE (12 or 24 words) whose derived key at m/44'/501'/0'/0' lands on the vanity address — importable as a recovery phrase into Phantom/Solflare/the Solana CLI (combined pattern capped at 2 chars, ~100× slower to grind). Otherwise a raw 64-byte private key is returned. SECURITY: the returned `privateKey64`/`mnemonic` is a REAL, fully-funded-capable secret. It transits the MCP channel in plaintext, so the MCP host (Claude Desktop, Cursor, any proxy) MAY LOG the entire response. Treat the whole tool result as a secret, import it into a wallet immediately, and never reuse a secret that may have been logged. Billed via x402 `exact` (flat $0.05 USDC on Solana).

maxIterations.description: Hard cap on grinder iterations. Default 1500000, clamped to 1500000.

mnemonic.description: Return a BIP-39 seed phrase (importable as a recovery phrase) instead of a raw private key. ~100× slower; combined prefix+suffix capped at 2 chars in this mode.

prefix.description: Base58 prefix the address must start with. Allowed chars: 123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz. 1-6 chars (longer prefixes are exponentially harder and are rejected).

strength.description: Mnemonic mode only: entropy bits — 128 → 12 words (default), 256 → 24 words.

suffix.description: Optional base58 suffix the address must end with. 1-6 chars.

name: vanity_grinder
title: Solana vanity grinder ($0.05)
